description: The file is a server-side PHP script for handling AJAX requests related to navigating and managing requirement and test project nodes in TestLink. It generates a JSON response representing nodes in a tree structure used for UI navigation, and includes functions to retrieve children nodes based on various filters, as well as external dependencies and configurations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class used to manage node types and hierarchy retrieval in the node tree structure.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Main function to query and format the child nodes of a given parent node, applying filters and operation modes.
